note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, and only soldiers and workers are described; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, antennae and labrum paler than the head capsule, mandibles dark brown with paler base, thorax and abdomen deep straw yellow. Pilosity of head sparse, pilosity of pronotum and body moderate. Body length 6.0–6.5 mm. Head capsule subrectangular (head length to base of mandibles 2.0–2.10, maximum width 1.53–1.63 mm), width about 3/4 of the length (width/length index 0.75–0.78); sides nearly parallel, slightly narrowed in the anterior third (width at base of mandibles 1.15 mm, width at mandible base/maximum width index 0.73); frons gently sloping forwards. Antennae 16-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Labrum subtriangular, apex acute (length 0.30, width 0.40 mm). Mandibles sickle-shaped, strong (length 1.15–1.22 mm), slightly longer than half the head length, mandible length/head length index 0.585. Left mandible with a laterally projecting tooth within the middle third, situated slightly above the middle, and not on the upper edge of the basal third as stated by Holmgren and Holmgren (1917) and Thakur (1981) (tooth distance/mandible length index 0.43); right mandible with a rudimentary tooth in the middle third. Postmentum subrectangular, sides slightly convex (length 1.20, maximum width 0.66 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.60–0.68, width 1.10–1.22 mm), anterior margin convex with a distinct median notch, posterior margin convex with a marked median notch; mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, posterior margin concave at the middle; metanotum as wide as or slightly narrower than the pronotum, posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to yellowish brown, antennae and postclypeus paler than the head capsule, thorax and abdomen creamy yellow. Pilosity of head and body moderate. Body length 3.5–4.4 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (head length to base of mandibles 1.25–1.40, width 1.35–1.53 mm). Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 subequal to segment 4 or shorter than segment 4, segment 5 shortest or subequal to segment 3. Postclypeus inflated, pilose, length less than 1/2 of the width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin convex with a distinct notch (recorded as a shallow incision by Holmgren and Holmgren 1917), posterior margin weakly convex, weakly concave at the middle (length 0.40–0.55, width 0.75–0.84 mm). Mesonotum narrower than the pronotum (width 0.70 mm), concave at the middle of the posterior margin; metanotum wider than the pronotum (width 0.88–0.90 mm), posterior margin straight.
